<div style="TEXT-ALIGN: left; TEXT-INDENT: 36pt"><font style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: 'Times New Roman'; FONT-STYLE: italic">(a)</font>&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;<font style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: 'Times New Roman'"><font style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: 'Times New Roman'; FONT-STYLE: italic">Dismissal of PricewaterhouseCoopers LLP. </font>On May 3, 2018, Tredegar Corporation (&#8220;Tredegar&#8221;) dismissed PricewaterhouseCoopers LLP (&#8220;PwC&#8221;) as its independent registered public accounting firm, upon the approval of the Audit Committee (the &#8220;Audit Committee&#8221;) of Tredegar&#8217;s Board of Directors (the &#8220;Board&#8221;).</font></div>

<div style="TEXT-ALIGN: left; TEXT-INDENT: 36pt">&#160;</div>

<div style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: 'Times New Roman'; TEXT-ALIGN: left; TEXT-INDENT: 36pt">The audit reports on the financial statements of Tredegar as of and for the fiscal years ended December 31, 2016 and 2017 issued by PwC did not contain any adverse opinion or disclaimer of opinion, nor were the reports qualified or modified as to uncertainty, audit scope or accounting principles.</div>

<div style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: 'Times New Roman'; TEXT-ALIGN: left; TEXT-INDENT: 36pt">&#160;</div>

<div style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: 'Times New Roman'; TEXT-ALIGN: left; TEXT-INDENT: 36pt">During Tredegar&#8217;s fiscal years ended December 31, 2016 and 2017 and the subsequent interim period through May 3, 2018, (1) there were no disagreements (as defined in Item 304(a)(1)(iv) of Regulation S-K and the related instruction thereto) between Tredegar and PwC on any matter of accounting principles or practices, financial statement disclosure or auditing scope or procedure, which disagreements, if not resolved to the satisfaction of PwC, would have caused PwC to make reference thereto in its report on Tredegar&#8217;s financial statements for such periods, and (2) there were no reportable events (as described in Item 304(a)(1)(v) of Regulation S-K).</div>

<div style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: 'Times New Roman'; TEXT-ALIGN: left; TEXT-INDENT: 36pt">&#160;</div>

<div style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: 'Times New Roman'; TEXT-ALIGN: left; TEXT-INDENT: 36pt">Tredegar requested that PwC furnish it with a letter addressed to the Securities and Exchange Commission stating whether PwC agrees with the above statements. A copy of PwC&#8217;s letter, dated May 7, 2018, is attached hereto as Exhibit 16.1.</div>

<div style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: 'Times New Roman'; TEXT-ALIGN: left; TEXT-INDENT: 36pt">&#160;</div>

<div style="TEXT-ALIGN: left; TEXT-INDENT: 36pt"><font style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: 'Times New Roman'; FONT-STYLE: italic">(b)</font>&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;<font style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: 'Times New Roman'"><font style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: 'Times New Roman'; FONT-STYLE: italic">Engagement of KPMG LLP.</font>&#160; On May 3, 2018, the Audit Committee approved the engagement of KPMG LLP (&#8220;KPMG&#8221;) to audit Tredegar&#8217;s financial statements as of and for the fiscal year ending December 31, 2018.</font></div>

<div style="TEXT-ALIGN: left; TEXT-INDENT: 36pt">&#160;</div>

<div style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: 'Times New Roman'; TEXT-ALIGN: left; TEXT-INDENT: 36pt">During Tredegar&#8217;s fiscal years ended December 31, 2016 and 2017 and the subsequent interim period May 3, 2018, Tredegar did not consult KPMG in regards to Tredegar&#8217;s financial statements, which were audited by PwC as its independent registered public accounting firm, with respect to (1) the application of accounting principles to a specified transaction, either completed or proposed, (2) the type of audit opinion that might be rendered on Tredegar&#8217;s financial statements or (3) any matter that was the subject of a disagreement (as defined in Item 304(a)(1)(iv) of Regulation S-K and the related instruction thereto) or a reportable event (as described in Item 304(a)(1)(v) of Regulation S-K).</div>

<div style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: 'Times New Roman'; TEXT-ALIGN: left; TEXT-INDENT: 36pt">On May 1, 2018, the Executive Compensation Committee (the &#8220;Compensation Committee&#8221;) of the Board approved a grant of nonstatutory stock options under the Tredegar Corporation 2018 Equity Incentive Plan to John D. Gottwald, Tredegar&#8217;s President and Chief Executive Officer, for a number of shares of Tredegar&#8217;s common stock equal to $2,000,000.&#160; The number of shares covered by the grant, which is effective the third business day following Tredegar&#8217;s 2018 annual meeting of shareholders (the &#8220;Effective Date&#8221;), will be computed using the ten-day average share price ending the day preceding the Effective Date.</div>

<div style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: 'Times New Roman'; TEXT-ALIGN: left; TEXT-INDENT: 36pt">On May 2, 2018, Tredegar held its 2018 Annual Meeting of Shareholders (the &#8220;Meeting&#8221;).&#160; As of March 9, 2018, the record date for the Meeting, there were a total of 33,114,349 shares of Tredegar&#8217;s common stock outstanding and entitled to vote at the Meeting.&#160; At the Meeting, 29,684,342 shares of Tredegar&#8217;s common stock, constituting approximately 89.64% of the outstanding shares on the record date for the Meeting, were represented in person or by proxy; therefore, a quorum was present.&#160; The results of the Meeting were as follows:</div>

<div><br>
</div>

<div style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: 'Times New Roman'; FONT-WEIGHT: bold; TEXT-ALIGN: left">Proposal 1 &#8211; Election of Directors</div>

<div style="TEXT-ALIGN: left"><br>
</div>

<div style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: 'Times New Roman'; TEXT-ALIGN: left; TEXT-INDENT: 36pt">THESE NONSTATUTORY STOCK OPTION TERMS AND CONDITIONS (&#8220;Terms and Conditions&#8221;) effective as of the [____] day of May, 2018, govern the nonstatutory stock option grant made by Tredegar Corporation, a Virginia corporation (the &#8220;Company&#8221;), to the participant (the &#8220;Participant&#8221;) named in the Notice of Stock Option Grant to which these Terms and Conditions are attached (the &#8220;Grant Notice&#8221;), and are made in accordance with and subject to the provisions of the Company&#8217;s 2018 Equity Incentive Plan (the &#8220;Plan&#8221;).&#160; A copy of the Plan has been made available to Participant.&#160; All terms used in these Terms and Conditions that are defined in the Plan have the same meaning given them in the Plan.</div>

<div><br>
</div>

<div style="TEXT-ALIGN: left; TEXT-INDENT: 36pt"><font style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: 'Times New Roman'">1.</font>&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160; &#160;&#160;&#160;<font style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: 'Times New Roman'"><font style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: 'Times New Roman'"><u>Grant of Option.</u></font>&#160; In accordance with the Plan, and effective as of the Date of Grant specified in the Grant Notice (the &#8220;Date of Grant&#8221;), the Company granted to Participant, subject to the terms and conditions of the Plan and these Terms and Conditions, the right and option to purchase from the Company all or part of the number of shares of Common Stock specified in the Grant Notice (the &#8220;Option&#8221;) at the option price specified in the Grant Notice (the &#8220;Option Price&#8221;).&#160; The number of shares of Common Stock that vest on each vesting date set forth in the Grant Notice are referred to as the &#8220;Vested Shares.&#8221; This Option is not an &#8220;incentive stock option&#8221; under Section 422 of the Code.&#160; This Option may be exercised in accordance with these Terms and Conditions.&#160; &#8220;Exercising&#8221; this Option means purchasing all or part of the shares of Common Stock specified in the Grant Notice at the Option Price.&#160; Participant may not transfer these shares except to the Participant&#8217;s Beneficiary.</font></div>

<div><br>
</div>

<div style="TEXT-ALIGN: left; TEXT-INDENT: 36pt"><font style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: 'Times New Roman'">2.</font>&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160; &#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;<font style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: 'Times New Roman'"><font style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: 'Times New Roman'"><u>Terms and Conditions.</u></font>&#160; This Option is subject to the following additional terms and conditions:</font></div>

<div><br>
</div>

<div style="TEXT-ALIGN: left; MARGIN-LEFT: 36pt; TEXT-INDENT: 36pt"><font style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: 'Times New Roman'">(a)</font>&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;<font style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: 'Times New Roman'"><font style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: 'Times New Roman'"><u>Expiration Date.</u></font>&#160; The Expiration Date of this Option shall be as specified in the Grant Notice.</font></div>

<div><br>
</div>

<div style="TEXT-ALIGN: left; MARGIN-LEFT: 36pt; TEXT-INDENT: 36pt"><font style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: 'Times New Roman'">(b)</font>&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;<font style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: 'Times New Roman'"><font style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: 'Times New Roman'"><u>Exercise of Option.</u></font>&#160; Except as otherwise provided in these Terms and Conditions, (i), this Option shall vest with respect to Vested Shares on the dates specified in the Grant Notice, and (ii) this Option shall be exercisable with respect to any Vested Shares until the Expiration Date.&#160; A partial exercise of this Option shall not affect Participant&#8217;s right to exercise this Option with respect to the remaining shares, subject to the conditions of the Plan and these Terms and Conditions.</font></div>

<div><br>
</div>

<div style="TEXT-ALIGN: left; MARGIN-LEFT: 36pt; TEXT-INDENT: 36pt"><font style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: 'Times New Roman'">(c)</font>&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;<font style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: 'Times New Roman'"><font style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: 'Times New Roman'"><u>Method of Exercising and Payment for Shares.</u></font>&#160; This Option must be exercised by written notice delivered to the attention of the Company&#8217;s Secretary at the Company&#8217;s principal office in Richmond, Virginia.&#160; The exercise date shall be (i) in the case of notice by mail or nationally recognized courier, the date of postmark or (ii) in the case of notice by any other means, the date of receipt by the Company&#8217;s Secretary.&#160; The notice must be accompanied by payment of the Option Price in full, in cash or cash equivalent acceptable to the Committee, or by the surrender of shares of Common Stock with an aggregate Fair Market Value (determined as of the day preceding the exercise date), that together with any cash or cash equivalent paid to exercise the Option, is not less than the Option Price for the number of shares of Common Stock for which the Option is exercised.</font></div>

<div style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: 'Times New Roman'; TEXT-ALIGN: right">Page <font id="DSPFPageNumber" style="FONT-SIZE: 8pt; FONT-FAMILY: 'Times New Roman'; FONT-WEIGHT: normal; FONT-STYLE: normal">1</font></div>

<div style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: 'Times New Roman'; FONT-WEIGHT: bold; TEXT-ALIGN: center">Tredegar</div>

<div style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: 'Times New Roman'; FONT-WEIGHT: bold; TEXT-ALIGN: center">Shareholder Meeting</div>

<div style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: 'Times New Roman'; FONT-WEIGHT: bold; TEXT-ALIGN: center">May<font style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: 'Times New Roman'">-</font>02<font style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: 'Times New Roman'">-</font>2018</div>

<div><br>

<div style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: 'Times New Roman'; TEXT-ALIGN: justify; BACKGROUND-COLOR: #ffffff">Good morning, ladies and gentlemen.&#160; I'm Bill Gottwald.&#160; I'm Chairman of the Board of Tredegar Corporation.</div>

<div style="BACKGROUND-COLOR: #ffffff"><br>
</div>

<div style="BACKGROUND-COLOR: #ffffff">
<div style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: 'Times New Roman'; TEXT-ALIGN: justify">Before we get going, I'll just say, I was watching TV, watching a show on TV last week, and the show was called How the Welsh Changed the World:&#160; A Tale of Two Tredegars.&#160; And it was real interesting.&#160; It was about the Tredegar in Wales that we get the name of the Tredegar Ironworks from, and I learned that, all these years--and I'm about to say welcome to our 29th annual meeting of the shareholders--we are supposed to be saying Tre-dE-gar according to the Welsh people.</div>

<div><br>
</div>

<div style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: 'Times New Roman'; TEXT-ALIGN: justify">So, anyway, welcome to our meeting.&#160; I understand that today's meeting is being webcast, so I extend a special welcome to anybody that's listening in.&#160; Before I begin with the business items, I'd like to introduce my colleagues on the Board of Directors, all of whom are here today and all of whom, including myself, are up for reelection to the Board.&#160; Directors, would you please stand when I call your name?&#160; George Freeman.&#160; John Gottwald.&#160; Ken Newsome.&#160; Greg Pratt.&#160; Tom Snead.&#160; John Steitz.&#160; Carl Tack.&#160; Thank you, guys.</div>

<div style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: 'Times New Roman'; TEXT-ALIGN: justify">Bapi--two things I think I wanted to note again -- is Bapi and his team had a record year last year and a very good first quarter.&#160; And that story is a lot behind that trend of improvement in the earnings.&#160; And so, thank you to that team.&#160; It's a wonderful performance.&#160; We really appreciate it.</div>

<div><br>

<div style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: 'Times New Roman'; TEXT-ALIGN: justify">But, he talked about his strategy of the Polaris.&#160; And in a nutshell, again, what he said was we have challenges and have opportunities, but the answer is the same.&#160; We need new customers, and we need new products.&#160; And they're working hard on both of those, and they're making good progress on both of those.&#160; And so, that's encouraging to me, and I wish him well with that strategy.</div>

<div><br>
</div>

<div style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: 'Times New Roman'; TEXT-ALIGN: justify">Steve didn't pull any punches here with you guys today.&#160; He reminded you here with this trend, $150 million of sales been lost over the last several years.&#160; I'm just repeating what he just said.&#160; And he also reminded you there's another 70 million coming.&#160; Some people might get intimidated by that.&#160; It's a heck of a challenge.&#160; But, I'm really particularly proud--I'm proud of everybody at Tredegar.&#160; It's been an interesting couple of years with a lot of good work by everybody.&#160; But, I'm really proud of Steve and the Personal Care team by not being intimidated.&#160; In fact, they've come out aggressive.&#160; They're not shrinking from this.&#160; They're going out with the capital.&#160; He talked to you about the capital for elastics, $35 million.&#160; And some people might be cutting expenses when you're losing business, but he's increasing expenses.&#160; He's increasing expenses in the R&amp;D area.&#160; I think I counted up like a $5 million increase over just the last two or three years, which is great.&#160; I hope it works.</div>

<div id="DSPFPageHeader" style="WIDTH: 100%">
<div style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: 'Times New Roman'; TEXT-ALIGN: right">Tredegar Shareholder Meeting</div>

<div style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: 'Times New Roman'; TEXT-ALIGN: right">May-02-2018</div>

<div style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: 'Times New Roman'; TEXT-ALIGN: right">Page <font id="DSPFPageNumber" style="FONT-SIZE: 8pt; FONT-FAMILY: 'Times New Roman'; FONT-WEIGHT: normal; FONT-STYLE: normal">23</font></div>

<div style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: 'Times New Roman'; TEXT-ALIGN: justify">Brook Hamilton:&#160; I hope I am, too.&#160; Well, first of all, thanks for the question.&#160; Appreciate it.&#160; My name is Brook Hamilton, President of Bonnell.</div>

<div><br>
</div>

<div style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: 'Times New Roman'; TEXT-ALIGN: justify">So, the question was do we expect Bonnell to be affected by aluminum tariffs.&#160; Maybe I'll expand upon that a little bit.&#160; The aluminum tariffs were applied to both the aluminum and steel industry as a result of the Administration's 232 investigation.&#160; And so, that has had an impact on the market.</div>

<div><br>
</div>

<div style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: 'Times New Roman'; TEXT-ALIGN: justify">But, more recently, the Administration also applied sanctions against Russia, and Russia is a large producer of aluminum, and their main producer called Rusal has been materially affected by these sanctions.&#160; So, the combination of tariffs and sanctions have had an impact on the market.&#160; And so, things have been pretty volatile over the last little bit, but year over year, the price of aluminum is up about 20%, so that might cause people to pause for a moment.</div>

<div><br>
</div>

<div style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: 'Times New Roman'; TEXT-ALIGN: justify">So, however, in general, our terms of sale allow us to pass through the base price of aluminum in the products that we sell.&#160; So, you can think of it as sort of a two-tiered pricing.&#160; There's the base price of aluminum, and then there's the spread over on top of that price that we charge for the conversion of billet into extrusion and further painting, anodizing, machining, etc., etc.</div>

<div>&#160;</div>

<div id="DSPFPageBreakArea" style="MARGIN-BOTTOM: 10pt; CLEAR: both; MARGIN-TOP: 10pt">
<div id="DSPFPageBreak" style="PAGE-BREAK-AFTER: always">
<hr style="BORDER-LEFT-WIDTH: 0px; HEIGHT: 2px; BORDER-RIGHT-WIDTH: 0px; BORDER-BOTTOM-WIDTH: 0px; COLOR: #000000; CLEAR: both; MARGIN: 4px 0px; BORDER-TOP-WIDTH: 0px; WIDTH: 100%; BACKGROUND-COLOR: #000000" noshade="noshade">
</div>

<div id="DSPFPageHeader" style="WIDTH: 100%">
<div style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: 'Times New Roman'; TEXT-ALIGN: right">Tredegar Shareholder Meeting</div>

<div style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: 'Times New Roman'; TEXT-ALIGN: right">May-02-2018</div>

<div style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: 'Times New Roman'; TEXT-ALIGN: right">Page <font id="DSPFPageNumber" style="FONT-SIZE: 8pt; FONT-FAMILY: 'Times New Roman'; FONT-WEIGHT: normal; FONT-STYLE: normal">24</font></div>
</div>
</div>

<div style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: 'Times New Roman'; TEXT-ALIGN: justify">So, when the prices go up or down, we adjust the base price for our customers.&#160; And so, our goal is to be neutral on metal.</div>

<div>&#160;</div>

<div style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: 'Times New Roman'; TEXT-ALIGN: justify">However, if prices continue to rise as they have done, there is a risk to the industry in that customers may elect to substitute products--substitute aluminum for other products.&#160; So, they may look at plastics or composites or other materials if the price of aluminum gets too much.</div>

<div><br>
</div>

<div style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: 'Times New Roman'; TEXT-ALIGN: justify">So, right now, things are pretty volatile.&#160; Prices have been up 20% more than they are right now, but they're 20% up year-over-year, as I mentioned.&#160; And so, they've been up and down quite dramatically.&#160; There have also been exceptions and extensions to the tariffs and to the sanctions, and so in some ways, we won't know the true impact to the industry for several months.&#160; So, we're in a little bit of a waiting game there.</div>

<div><br>
</div>

<div style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: 'Times New Roman'; TEXT-ALIGN: justify">But, I think the takeaway is that, as prices for our raw material go up or down, we pass those on to our customers, and we're not affected financially as a result of those changes.&#160; So, thanks for the question.</div>
